decision_question: Release the supervised maintenance contract and read-only collectors, with initial schedules restricted to audit and local preparation?
criteria: references/maintenance-design.md C1-C8, frozen before instruction refinement

shared_model_or_source_limits: Shared frozen design and package sources
No independent live executor or unseen cross-host holdout
independence.tools_permissions: Read-only files and allowed structural/unit checks; no reviewer external mutations

findings: Versioned state and separate mail acknowledgement
Stable incident identity and bounded retries
Atomic state and partial failure semantics

falsification_hypotheses: Target changes between reread and mutation
Same-SHA manual success skipped the failing job

test_results.disposition: Unattended mutations deferred; destructive operations require expected-tip guards
Unattended pushes deferred; explicit downstream-trigger review required
Pure policy test rejects false coverage flag; deriving that flag from real adapters remains untested

negotiator.scope: Supervised package; scheduled audit/triage and explicitly authorized isolated local preparation only
negotiator.required_before_finalization: Add this missing versioned evidence record and rerun package checks

structural_tests: Run package validators and version-matched tests; see grading.json
limitations: No automatic merge, prune, push, PR creation, deployment or acknowledgement in initial schedule
Lock/crash/revocation/notification deduplication are operating contracts, not an executed scheduling-engine benchmark
Pure gates validate supplied observations, not authenticity or completeness of provider evidence
Live estate repairs are incident evidence, not a controlled with-skill/without-skill evaluation
